This value indicates that a new iCloud account is available, and the persistent store in use will or did transition to the new account.
This value indicates that no iCloud account is available, and the persistent store in use will or did transition to the “local” store.
This value indicates that the user has wiped the contents of the iCloud account, usually using Delete All from Documents & Data in Settings.

This value indicates that the Core Data integration has finished building a store file that is consistent with the contents of the iCloud account, and is ready to replace the fallback store with that file.

userInfo.doc: The user info dictionary of the receiver.

validationPredicates.doc: The validation predicates of the receiver.

validationWarnings.doc: The error strings associated with the receiver’s validation predicates.

versionHash.doc: The version hash for the receiver.

versionHashModifier.doc: The version hash modifier for the receiver.

name.doc: The name of the property in the destination entity for the property mapping.

userInfo.doc: The user info for the property mapping.

valueExpression.doc: The value expression for the property mapping.

currentQueryGenerationToken.doc: A token that informs a context to use the current generation.

deleteRule.doc: The rule to apply when you delete the relationship’s owning managed object.

destinationEntity.doc: The type of object the relationship contains.

inverseRelationship.doc: The relationship that represents the inverse of the current relationship.

maxCount.doc: The maximum number of managed objects the relationship can reference.

minCount.doc: The minimum number of managed objects the relationship can reference.

ordered.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the relationship preserves the order of the referenced managed objects.

toMany.doc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the relationship can contain many managed objects.

deletedObjects.doc: The objects that were deleted in the calling context.

insertedObjects.doc: The objects that were inserted into the calling context.

lockedObjects.doc: The objects that were flagged for optimistic locking on the calling context.

updatedObjects.doc: The objects that were modified in the calling context.

container.doc: The container that provides access to the migrating persistent store.

init(_:).doc: Creates a migration manager with the specified stages.
